name: TrackDuration
description:
# trackDuration
TrackDuration keeps timed effects attached to tokens in the turn order, counting them down automatically as combat advances — and counting them back up if you rewind.

## What it does

- **Attach effects to tokens** with a colour marker, a name, and a round count. The count is appended directly to the token's name (e.g. `Kaanan 🔹10`) so it is always visible on the board.
- **Counts down automatically** when a token's turn ends (the GM presses the forward button). Counts back up when a turn is rewound (backward button).
- **Expiry notices** are whispered to the GM and the character's controller when a duration reaches zero. The effect is removed from the token name automatically.
- **Interactive report card** — type `!duration` to see all active effects with token thumbnails, round counts, and inline edit buttons. The card header includes one-click buttons to refresh, clear, or open help.
- **Edit any duration on the fly** — the edit button next to each effect opens a pre-filled prompt. Set it to 0 or below to remove the effect immediately.
- **Map-change recovery** — clearing the turn order (or using the ∅ button) broadcasts a restore panel to all players. Restore buttons re-attach effects to the matching character's token on the new turn order.

## Getting started

1. Install the script via One-Click or paste `Duration.js` into your campaign's API console.
2. Build up your turn order as normal.
3. When a character gains a timed effect, make sure their token is at the top of the turn order, then click **+ Add Effect to Active Character** in the `!duration` card (or call `!duration --add` directly).
4. Choose a colour marker from the dropdown, enter the duration in rounds, and name the effect.
5. Advance the turn order normally — durations count themselves down.

## Commands

- `!duration` — show the active effects report card.
- `!duration --add <marker> <rounds> <name>` — add a timed effect to the top token.
- `!duration --edit <tokenId> <value> <name>` — set a specific effect to a new value (generated by the edit button; not typically typed by hand).
- `!duration --clear yes` — clear all effects and broadcast the restore panel.
- `!duration --help` — show the in-chat help card.

## Notes

- Only tokens present in the turn order are tracked.
- Ticking is driven by the GM's forward/backward turn order buttons. Manual reordering does not trigger a tick.
- The restore workflow expects the character to already be on the new map's turn order before clicking Restore.
